body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

Some feedback:

- The **Repeat** option should be hidden in the inspector when using the conic gradient mode, as they have no effect no matter the from/to positions. You can do this by adding `GradientTexture2D::_validate_property()`, similar to the existing method in the Gradient class. Then call `notify_property_list_changed();` at the end of `GradientTexture2D::set_fill()`.

Regarding this CI failure:

```
 ./scene/resources/gradient_texture.cpp: In member function 'float GradientTexture2D::_get_gradient_offset_at(int, int) const':
./scene/resources/gradient_texture.cpp:305:36: error: ISO C++ says that these are ambiguous, even though the worst conversion for the first is better than the worst conversion for the second: [-Werror]
  305 |                 ofs = Math::fposmod((pos - fill_from).angle() - (fill_to - fill_from).angle(), (float)Math::TAU) / Math::TAU;
      |                       ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

You probably need to wrap `(pos - fill_from)` as `float(pos - fill_from)` (possibly also for `(fill_to - fill_from)`).

> Is the CI error is a false positive? The only thing I could find in the logs were:

I don't see that particular CI failure in the log anymore. I could only see the one I linked above.
